definitions: The omission from speech or writing of a word or words that are superfluous or able to be understood from contextual clues.
A series of three dots (...) indicating an intentional omission of a word, sentence, or whole section from a text without altering its original meaning.
A mark or series of marks used in writing to indicate an omission, especially of letters or words.
examples: An ellipsis can indicate a pause.
He used an ellipsis to shorten the quote.
